label: Procurement and Vendor Management Team
blurb: A Procurement Manager and 4 specialists who source suitable vendors and coordinate evaluation and ongoing obligations
purpose: For a business that wants to source suitable vendors and coordinate evaluation and ongoing obligations.

project.name: Procurement and Vendor Management
project.goal: A clear first plan for procurement and vendor management, with milestones, an owner for each, and what done looks like.
